summary: Regression tested P1 refactor of NovaChatPanel into NovaStatusStrip / NovaFeedbackCard / NovaComposer on /help route. All refactored testIDs and interactions render correctly under surfaceVariant='embedded'. Sending a message produced a live assistant reply within ~10s and per-message action pills (audio/thumbs-up/thumbs-down/favorite-toggle) rendered as expected. Dark theme applied cleanly with correct v2 tokens (no hardcoded broken colors observed). Zero-behavior-change refactor confirmed.
action_items: OPTIONAL / not a regression: gpsState.messaging.quick_questions came back empty for p1.free user on /help, so quick-q-0..3 chips did not render in the welcome view. Verify whether quick_questions payload is expected to be populated from GPS for free-tier users; unrelated to the refactor since the code path in NovaChatPanel is unchanged and still maps over the passed prop.

CLARIFICATION for review request: chat-nova-status-detail is intentionally NOT rendered when surfaceVariant='embedded' (as on /help); chat-nova-status-inline-detail is rendered instead in the same status row. NovaFeedbackCard is also intentionally suppressed when isEmbedded||isFloating (both pre-existing behaviors, preserved). Both matched prior iterations 790-794 behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: NovaChatPanel.tsx now cleanly delegates: NovaFeedbackCard rendered inside ScrollView (correct — it must scroll with messages); NovaComposer renders NovaStatusStrip internally. Component boundaries are logical and props are explicitly forwarded — good separation.

NovaFeedbackCard.tsx line 30: `showFeedback && !feedbackSent && !isEmbedded && !isFloating` — this means on /help (embedded) the feedback card never renders even though thumbs-up sets showFeedback=true and feedbackRating. The rating update still happens, but user sees no UI response. Prior behavior confirmed unchanged, but noting as UX gap that MAY warrant a follow-up: either surface the feedback panel in embedded variant, or hide thumbs-up buttons when card cannot be shown.

NovaStatusStrip.tsx line 60: gps status text hardcodes English strings ('GPS LIVE'/'GPS DEGRADED'/'source'/'freshness'/'s') — not going through tx()/t(). Not caused by refactor (was inline in NovaChatPanel previously), but worth i18n-izing.
NovaFeedbackCard.tsx line 60: relies on globalThis.__alphaColor — same as prior code; verify this global is always initialized before feedback card renders (no visible break in test).
